validation: experimental; no hardware available; tests use synthetic reports
model: Rainy75 RGB Standard / Pro shared IDs; not Lite, RT, or custom ZMK
implementation: Independent implementation of VIA query format; no third-party source code copied.
format: 320F:5055 USB / 320F:5088 receiver; FF60:0061. VIA command 01 and CUSTOM_GET 08/channel 3/fields 1,2 only.
limitations: No supported USB/receiver battery query found. No battery capability advertised.
Rainy75Control obtains battery from macOS Bluetooth services, not from VIA.
Reverse-engineering lighting observations come from Pro ISO hardware; standard firmware compatibility remains unverified.
Brightness is a 0-9 setting, not a percentage or master backlight power state.
A plugged-in receiver does not establish an active wireless keyboard connection.
